changelog:
v1.0.3 Release Notes & Features:
• Bulk 1-to-1 Caption Assignment: Sequential line-by-line caption pasting across all Meta Business Suite Reel description boxes.
• 1-3s Humanized Delay: Random 1 to 3 seconds pause between pasting each description for stealth bot protection.
• Clean Single-Line Commenting: Auto-sanitizes comments to post exactly 1 clean comment per profile in FB Reels Auto Commenter.
• No-Page Account Protection: Auto-detects accounts without active Pages, logs the report, returns to Home, waits 3-4s, and closes the browser to prevent personal profile posting.
• Instant Session Cookie Sync: Injects saved cookies immediately on startup so Facebook opens 100% logged in on the 1st second.
